name: HZ_IMP_ENTITY_DETAILS
description: The HZ_IMP_ENTITY_DETAILS table stores detailed information about the entities in the interface tables to import. The table includes number of records for each entity, the definition and results from enrichment functions during import.

columns.name: ENTITY_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the row

columns.name: NUM_WARNED
columns.description: Number of records warned

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity lookup code

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a batch

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records in an entity counted by import

columns.name: SELECTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate if the entity is selected in import definition

columns.name: BD_DUP_COUNT
columns.description: Number of duplicate entity records identified by batch deduplication

columns.name: BD_DUP_ACTION
columns.description: Action to take by duplicate identification within the batch. Validated against lookup HZ_IMP_BATCH_DEDUP_ACTIONS

columns.name: RD_DUP_COUNT
columns.description: Number of duplicate records identified by registry deduplication.

columns.name: RD_DUP_SET_COUNT
columns.description: Number of duplicate record sets identified by registry deduplication.

columns.name: RD_DUP_ACTION
columns.description: Action to take by duplicate identification between the interface tables and the TCA Registry for duplicate entities that cross the automatic merge threshold. Validated against lookup HZ_IMP_REGISTRY_DEDUP_ACTIONS

columns.name: RD_POS_DUP_COUNT
columns.description: Number of possible duplicates for an entity identified by registry deduplication

columns.name: RD_POS_DUP_ACTION
columns.description: Action to take by duplicate identification between the interface tables and the TCA Registry for duplicate entities that did not cross the automatic merge threshold. Validated against lookup HZ_IMP_REGISTRY_DEDUP_ACTIONS

columns.name: NUM_INSERTED
columns.description: Number of records inserted

columns.name: NUM_UPDATED
columns.description: Number of records updated

columns.name: NUM_MERGE_REQUESTED
columns.description: Number of records with merge requested

columns.name: NUM_AUTO_MERGED
columns.description: Number of records automatically merged

columns.name: NUM_REMOVED
columns.description: Number of records removed

columns.name: NUM_IMPORTED
columns.description: Number of records imported

columns.name: NUM_ADDR_CLEANSED
columns.description: Number of records cleansed by address validation

columns.name: NUM_ERRORS
columns.description: Number of records with error

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
